sub_graphs.title: Phase 0 Validator: Attestation Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the full attestation lifecycle from duty discovery through attestation creation, submission, aggregation, and inclusion in a block.

nodes.label: Epoch Start
nodes.description: New epoch begins; validator queries committee assignments for current and next epoch.

nodes.label: Get Committee Assignment
nodes.description: Call get_committee_assignment(state, epoch, validator_index) to obtain committee list, committee index, and assigned slot.

nodes.label: Attestation Duty Known
nodes.description: Validator knows assigned slot, committee index, and subnet ID for upcoming attestation.

nodes.label: Attestation Slot Arrived
nodes.description: The assigned attestation slot has started; validator waits for block or 1/3 slot duration.

nodes.label: Create Attestation
nodes.description: Construct AttestationData: set slot, committee index, beacon_block_root (head), source (justified checkpoint), target (current epoch boundary). Set aggregation bit. Sign with DOMAIN_BEACON_ATTESTER.

nodes.label: Broadcast Attestation
nodes.description: Publish attestation to beacon_attestation_{subnet_id} gossip topic.

nodes.label: Attestation Broadcast
nodes.description: Individual attestation published to subnet; awaiting potential aggregation.

nodes.label: Check Aggregator Selection
nodes.description: Compute slot_signature, check if hash(signature) % modulo == 0 where modulo = max(1, committee_size / TARGET_AGGREGATORS_PER_COMMITTEE).

nodes.label: Aggregate Attestations
nodes.description: If selected as aggregator: collect matching attestations from gossip, merge aggregation_bits and BLS signatures, create AggregateAndProof.

nodes.label: Broadcast Aggregate
nodes.description: Publish signed AggregateAndProof to beacon_aggregate_and_proof global gossip topic at 2/3 slot duration.

nodes.label: Aggregate Broadcast
nodes.description: Aggregated attestation published; available for inclusion in next block.

external_entities.name: Beacon Node
external_entities.description: Node providing chain state, fork choice head, and gossip network access to the validator client.

external_entities.name: P2P Gossip Network
external_entities.description: Libp2p gossipsub network carrying attestation and aggregate topics.

sub_graphs.title: Phase 0 Validator: Block Proposal Process
sub_graphs.description: Models the block proposal process including parent selection, block body construction, ETH1 voting, operation packing, state root computation, and signing.

nodes.label: Proposal Slot Arrived
nodes.description: Validator is the designated proposer for the current slot.

nodes.label: Select Parent Block
nodes.description: Run fork choice to determine head; use get_proposer_head for re-org consideration; select parent with parent.slot < block.slot.

nodes.label: Construct RANDAO Reveal
nodes.description: Sign current epoch with BLS using DOMAIN_RANDAO to produce RANDAO reveal.

nodes.label: Select ETH1 Data Vote
nodes.description: Evaluate candidate ETH1 blocks within valid timestamp range satisfying follow distance; vote for most-popular or latest candidate.

nodes.label: Pack Block Operations
nodes.description: Include: proposer slashings (max 16), attester slashings (max 2), attestations (max 128), deposits (max 16), voluntary exits (max 16). Must process deposits sequentially with valid Merkle proofs.

nodes.label: Compute State Root
nodes.description: Run state transition on unsigned block with stub state_root; compute resulting state root.

nodes.label: Sign Block
nodes.description: Sign complete block with BLS using DOMAIN_BEACON_PROPOSER. Check slashing protection DB first.

nodes.label: Block Broadcast
nodes.description: Signed beacon block published to the network.

external_entities.name: ETH1 Chain
external_entities.description: Ethereum 1.0 chain providing deposit data and block hashes for ETH1 voting.

sub_graphs.title: Phase 0 Validator: Slashing Protection
sub_graphs.description: Models the slashing protection mechanisms validators must implement to avoid double-signing blocks or producing conflicting attestations.

nodes.label: Signing Request Received
nodes.description: Validator client received a request to sign a block or attestation.

nodes.label: Check Block Slashing DB
nodes.description: Query persistent disk DB: has a block already been signed for this slot? If yes, refuse to sign.

nodes.label: Check Attestation Slashing DB
nodes.description: Query persistent disk DB: would this attestation (source, target epochs) create a double vote or surround vote with any prior attestation? If yes, refuse to sign.

nodes.label: Check Far-Future Attack
nodes.description: Reject attestation if target epoch is more than ~6 hours ahead of local clock to prevent far-future signing lockout.

nodes.label: Record and Sign
nodes.description: Write signing record to persistent disk BEFORE generating signature and broadcasting.

nodes.label: Signing Refused
nodes.description: Signing request rejected due to slashing risk or far-future attack detection.

nodes.label: Signed Safely
nodes.description: Message signed with slashing protection record persisted to disk.

edges.label: No conflict; safe to sign block
No conflict and not far-future; safe to sign

external_entities.name: Beacon Node (Untrusted)
external_entities.description: Beacon node providing signing requests; validator client should treat it as potentially compromised.

ambiguities.text: The spec says attestation should be created when block is received or 1/3 slot elapsed 'whichever comes first' but does not specify behavior when the received block is invalid.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume validator creates attestation at 1/3 slot mark if no valid block is received; an invalid block is treated as no block.

ambiguities.text: The far-future attestation protection suggests rejecting attestations >6 hours in future but this threshold is not formally specified as a protocol constant.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementations choose a reasonable threshold (e.g., 6 hours / ~1800 slots) as a client-level safety parameter.

ambiguities.text: If a slashing and voluntary exit for the same validator are included in the same block, the exit fails because slashing is processed first, making the block invalid.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume block proposers must check for this conflict before including both operations for the same validator.

implicit_assumptions.description: The validator client treats the beacon node as untrusted and validates all signing requests against its local slashing protection database.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A compromised beacon node could trick the validator into double-signing, resulting in slashing and loss of stake.

implicit_assumptions.description: The validator's local clock is reasonably synchronized with the network (within a few seconds).
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Validator may miss attestation/proposal slots, produce untimely messages, or be vulnerable to far-future attestation attacks.

implicit_assumptions.description: The validator maintains a persistent slashing protection database that survives crashes and restarts.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: After a crash, validator could re-sign conflicting messages for the same slot/epoch, leading to slashing.
